basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student currently attending CSULB, where I'm majoring in Computer Science. I live off-campus in Long Beach, California. My interests include gaming, Japanese comedy shows like GakiNoTsukai, and I'm a big fan of the band Death. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes or during breaks. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new music and catching up on my favorite shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science due to my ongoing studies at CSULB. Additionally, I taught myself basic Japanese through online courses to better appreciate my favorite shows. My interest in music has led me to learn a lot about different genres, especially metal.
